items.description: Hotel Holiday Inn Bogota Airport is located just 10 minutes from El Dorado International Airport and offers a complimentary Hotel-Airport-Hotel shuttle service from 05:00 to 22:40. Our guests will find a new style of hospitality with a warm welcome, modern facilities, unlimited internet access throughout the hotel, comfortable rooms with soundproofed windows and air-conditioned. The Hotel counts with ten meeting rooms for up to 300 people. Our guests can be delighted with our exquisite food at the Nativo Restaurant Bar. Close to the hotel is the Bogota Chamber of Commerce, Connecta, the United States Embassy, Corferias, Agora and the High Performance Sports Center. In addition, the financial area of 26th street where global companies like Unilever, Marsh, GSK and Coca Cola are located as well as DHL, Teleperformance in Connecta 26. On the other hand, if our guests are looking for a bit of fun, they will find the Salitre Plaza Shopping Mall, Plaza Claro Shopping Mall, Botanical Garden, Maloka Interactive Center and Pricesmart just 5 minutes away. In 5 minutes by car, you will find the Gran Estación shopping center, the Simón Bolívar Metropolitan Park and the Salitre Mágico amusement park.

items.description: One of the most visited cities in the world offers a tantalizing blend of warm hospitality and a magical blend of multiculturalism. Guests of the Holiday Inn Express and Suites Bogota DC have the best option to visit Colombia. Guests and visitors prefer to stay in our hotel for its modernity, comfort, care, and unique location. A business guest will find it easy to reach their business meetings because we are located in the financial heart of the city with companies like Baker Hughes, Caracol, Cisco Systems, World Bank, and Microsoft. We have smoke-free rooms, wireless high-speed Internet, a complimentary Business Center available 24 hours, free parking, Fitness Center, and 24-hour medical service. In addition, we have two modern and spacious meeting rooms with a capacity of 100 people each. We have an exclusive location adjacent to the Gastronomical Area. One of the most visited cities in the world offers a tantalizing blend of warm hospitality and a magical blend of multiculturalism.

items.description: Contemporary Hotel in Bogota near Park 93 Whether you're traveling to Colombia for business or planning a vacation in Bogotá, the best hotel choice is the Holiday Inn Express® Bogota. You will enjoy staying near 93 Park , the World Trade Center, major embassies such as France, Spain and Korea, important companies and upscale shopping malls like Centro Comercial Andino. Our location makes it easy to enjoy the area. We are within walking distance to many restaurants and bars and the city center is only five miles away. Spend the day at the Gold Museum or the Botero Museum, ride the funicular railway to Cerro de Monserrate, and enjoy 93 Park, a nearby exclusive area that offers upscale, designer shopping and historic attractions in north Bogotá. Remember to visit the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquira, one of the Wonders of the Colombia located less than 30 miles away. Our contemporary rooms are ideal for business travelers. They offer amenities like free high-speed Internet access, ergonomic chairs and a laptop safe. A 24-hour business center and a meeting room are also available. Always conscious about the environment, Holiday Inn Express® Bogota is certified with the Colombian Environmental Seal. A complimentary hot breakfast and an equipped Fitness Center are available every day for our guests, and professional staff will ensure the best hotel accommodation for your next business trip or vacation in Bogotá.
